name: Integration Health
description: Shows whether your vendor data feeds are still running. Every integration that reports in gets a row: when it last ran, whether it succeeded, and when it is next due. A feed that goes quiet past its schedule is flagged and raises a task, so silent breakage surfaces here instead of in a support ticket weeks later. Only integrations that have reported at least once and declared a schedule can be monitored.
author: VCTRS
